market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil at $97, weak August jobs data, and Norway bond sale. Expect volatility in equities and rates. Energy and commodities lead; tech rotates internally. Dollar weakness supports EM. Key risk: Iran conflict escalation vs. Trump's 'brief campaign' signal creating whipsaw.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure capex cycle continues but shifts from chips to power/data centers. EM currencies in multi-year uptrend. Energy transition accelerates (geothermal, Permian M&A). Consumer bifurcation persists. Fed likely to pivot to easing if labor data confirms cooling. Geopolitical risk premium remains embedded in oil and food prices.
